title: Vatican archives ceremony with Bledsoe's photo

tellings.quote: Yeah, they had a ceremony. They put my picture in the picture of the pope on the outside of the archives and then they placed my photo between the books of Galileo and Capernicus.

plain: In 2017 there was a ceremony at the Vatican archives where a photo taken by Chris Bledsoe was placed between books by Galileo and Copernicus, and his picture was hung beside the pope's outside the archives. That is according to Bledsoe himself, a man who says he has had repeated UFO encounters, and he passes it on from what he was told by Diana Pasulka, a religion professor, and a man named Timothy Taylor. To him it is a sign that the Church takes his experience seriously.
